title: What changes ownership in Ulysses AllToAll?
scope: Original four tokens × four heads × four ranks; head dimension omitted. Ordinary multihead attention with compatible divisibility; no GQA replication. Every token–head pair appears exactly once.

steps.label: Token-row ownership
steps.description: Rank Rt owns all four heads of token t. Ownership labels refer to ranks, not tensor values.

steps.label: AllToAll transpose
steps.description: Route each (t,h) tile to rank Rh. Each destination now owns all tokens for one head; no token–head pair is duplicated or dropped.

steps.label: Local attention per head
steps.description: Each rank computes its complete head across all four tokens. Ownership stays by head; attention values change. No other head’s scores are needed.
cards: t0: h0→R0 h1→R1 h2→R2 h3→R3 | t1: h0→R0 h1→R1 h2→R2 h3→R3 | t2: h0→R0 h1→R1 h2→R2 h3→R3 | t3: h0→R0 h1→R1 h2→R2 h3→R3 · attention computed

steps.label: Inverse AllToAll
steps.description: Route each output (t,h) back to rank Rt. Token-row ownership is restored for following layers; outputs are computed attention values, not unchanged inputs.
cards: t0: h0→R0 h1→R0 h2→R0 h3→R0 | t1: h0→R1 h1→R1 h2→R1 h3→R1 | t2: h0→R2 h1→R2 h2→R2 h3→R2 | t3: h0→R3 h1→R3 h2→R3 h3→R3 · output values

guard: Bijection and inverse preserve all sixteen identities; movement is not communication latency.
